chapter_seo_title: Wounded Xiao Chen Faces the Royal Celestial Maiden in a Tense Standoff
chapter_meta_description: After barely surviving Wang Zifeng's self-destruction, Xiao Chen must confront the vengeful Princess Zhao Lin'er. Can he talk his way out, or will he flee into the storm?
og_title: Chapter 11: The Royal Celestial Maiden Appears
og_description: Xiao Chen crosses words and swords with the beautiful but deadly Zhao Lin'er. A clash of wills on a primordial island.
twitter_description: Zhao Lin'er catches up to a wounded Xiao Chen. Old debts and new dangers collide.
